degraded.description: The stages that fell back to a lower-quality path on this request (#748). OMITTED — never an empty array — when nothing degraded, so an undegraded response is byte-identical to one from a server that predates the field. Present means: still a 200, still real results, but lower quality than this server normally produces (see degraded_entry.json for what each component means). Callers should not treat it as an error.
